text: BadInput tests: 15 malformed map cases, missing/dir/binary map and list files, empty list, unknown id, bad gen --out path, no args; each one error line exit 2, no traceback
Collision test: two products on one cell with same name, repeated list ids; all 4 picks counted (items=4/4)
OneBadPart tests: out-of-grid, id-only, non-dict, bad-type records and unreachable product not requested still run; requested broken or unreachable fails with id named
test_trace_recount: distance and time recomputed from the event trace with literal constants and a separate BFS, adjacency and wall checks
Hostile scale: 301x301 maze, 300x300 aisles and islands; 1-cell store; 150-item list on 100x150 aisles
Heuristic missed optimum by 2m on a 6-item list (open layout), found by brute-force test
Added exact Held-Karp order up to 10 stops; heuristic kept above, tested within 8% of optimum
150-item basket takes 23s (2-opt/or-opt is O(n^3) per pass); fine for baskets up to about 50 items
